title: Settle canonical transaction v1
description: Normalized transaction produced by the M3 CSV/OFX importers. descriptor_raw is stored encrypted with the account data key; descriptor_clean is the searchable, lower-cased form.

amountMinor.description: Signed minor units. Negative is money out, positive is money in.

descriptorRaw.description: Bank descriptor exactly as it appeared in the file, encrypted at rest.

descriptorClean.description: Lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed descriptor used for matching and display.

merchantId.description: Optional merchant key once a descriptor is resolved.

externalId.description: FITID for OFX/QFX; null for CSV.

dedupeKey.description: SHA-256 over account, date, signed amount, clean descriptor and occurrence index.
